svg.title: Calls versus messages sent to Discord
svg.desc: Twelve hundred Update calls over twenty seconds result in only four messages, one per real change.
svg.text: Update every frame if you like
20 seconds of gameplay at 60 fps: 1,200 calls to Update(), 4 messages to Discord.
More than 5 changes within 20 s? The newest one waits for a free slot, the ones in between are skipped.
